outcome: Superoxide dismutase activity in fetal brain tissue
Malondialdehyde activity in fetal brain tissue
Carnitine acylcarnitine translocase activity in fetal brain tissue
Glutathione activity in fetal brain tissue
Oxidative damage to fetal brain tissue
cohort: Female rats were exposed to chemotherapeutic drugs prior to pregnancy, then mated, and their fetuses' brain tissues were analyzed on the 20th day of gestation.
finding: Exposure to chemotherapeutic drugs (CYC and DOX) prior to pregnancy can lead to oxidative damage in fetal brain tissue, and Quercetin demonstrates a protective antioxidant effect.
